title: Basic hiragana: R and W rows and ん — find the sign
description: Choose the written sign from three visible kana using a basic sound or specified spelling context. 8 independent targets.

review.provenance: Independently authored F05 sign exercises and explanations; no CSV or mock curriculum reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-authored English copy and glosses; basic kana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party text, recordings, or audio used.
